title: Before You Board
why: Behind-the-scenes walk-through for planners who want to picture the day: dock, boats, captain, route.
hook_options: What happens before you step on board
A boat day, from the dock side
The part of the trip nobody films
caption: The captain checks the sky, the boat gets stocked by you, and the bayou does the rest. A quick look at a boat day on Bayou Bienvenue from our side of the dock. #neworleans #nolapartybarge #behindthescenes #bayoubienvenue

slides.headline: What happens before you step on board
The captain checks the sky first
slides.body: Rain is fine, the deck is covered. Lightning is not, and that is the captain's call.

slides.headline: 2101 Paris Road, inside Orleans Parish
slides.body: Our dock on Bayou Bienvenue. Fifteen minutes from the Quarter, no bridge to cross.

slides.headline: Four boats, four names, all motorized
slides.body: Freaky Tiki, Twerkin' Tiki, Party Queen, Bayou Boogie. A licensed captain drives every one.

slides.headline: Stock the bar. Pair the speaker.
slides.body: Bring the cooler. Pick one phone for aux. The boat is ready when you are.

slides.headline: Yes, there is a restroom
slides.body: Full restroom on board, every trip. Ask us how many times a week we answer this.

slides.headline: Marsh on both sides, city behind you
slides.body: Bayou Bienvenue is wild water inside the city limits.

slides.headline: The captain knows where to look
slides.body: Pelicans on the pilings, egrets in the grass, the odd gator. Common, not guaranteed.

slides.headline: Back at the dock in 1 hour 45
slides.body: The Uber is 15 minutes. Frenchmen Street is just warming up.

slides.headline: We handle the boat. You bring the people.
